qa.question: Should Site B be 372 MW as in the Southwest Power Pool queue, not 342 MW?
qa.finding: The Southwest Power Pool queue entry GEN-2024-323 (https://opsportal.spp.org/Studies/GIActive) lists 372 MW for the Hugo project at the ITC Hugo 7 345 kV substation. The database has 342 MW from six SGT-800 turbines. A Construction Review article (https://constructionreviewonline.com/1b-hugo-plant-expansion-western-farmers-electric-breaks-ground-on-nine-gas-turbines-in-oklahoma/) says the nine turbines add about 400 MW, and a cooperative annual report says 404 MW.
qa.recommendation: Leave 342 MW as it is, since queue sizes often include extra margin. The total of 415.5 MW for both sites is close to the 404 MW to 415 MW reported.
qa.note: I read the Southwest Power Pool open queue list on 5 November 2026 (https://opsportal.spp.org/Studies/GenerateActiveCSV). Entry GEN-2024-323 shows a nameplate of 372 MW and a capacity of 356.8 MW, with commercial operation in May 2029. Site A is 73.5 MW in the database and entry GEN-2026-SR34 shows 75 MW, owned by the cooperative, at the Hugo 138 kV substation, with commercial operation in April 2029.
